files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Join trips.csv to riders.csv on rider_id and use each rider's membership (trimmed and lower-cased). `result` should be a table indexed by membership in alphabetical order with columns trips (count), riders (number of distinct riders with trips) and mean_fare (average of non-empty fares, 2 decimals).
intended_computation: Read trips.csv and riders.csv; attach each trip's rider membership (strip, lower case); per membership: trips = count, riders = number of distinct riders with trips, mean_fare = mean of non-empty fares (2 decimals). Index membership, alphabetical.
